step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the X-Author add-in.
Log in to X-Author Contracts, as described here.
From X-Author Contracts pane, click the left-hand menu icon and select X-Author Templates.
In the X-Author Templates pane, go to Start tab > Search > Search Templates.

Use the Search box to search for an agreement template by keyword. Click the filter icon to expose drop-down menus that can help you to refine your search according to Template Type, Category, Subcategory, Locale, and Language.
From the list of documents, click the down arrow to expand and view guidance for the template.
Click Open to download a copy of the template.
Check your Downloads folder for the file and open it in Word.

postreq.p: Your template will be opened. Edit text and other static content in your template. When you are finished, click Check-in to check-in your template.
